description.zh: 任务流ID，任务流的唯一标识。可通过调用[ListTaskFlowInstance](~~424689~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlowInstance](~~424689~~) operation to query the task flow ID.

description.zh: 新Owner的用户ID。可通过调用接口[GetUser](~~147098~~)或[ListUsers](~~141938~~)获取UserId的值。
description.en: The user ID of the new owner. You can call the [GetUser](~~147098~~) or [ListUsers](~~141938~~) operation to query the user ID.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

>  To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~).

descriptions.zh: 转交限制：新的任务流Owner必须在同一租户下。
descriptions.en: Note: The new owner of the task flow must belong to the same tenant as the previous owner.
